descriptionChirho: A different or additional person, thing, or group; the primary adjectival sense of אַחֵר covering both 'another' (an additional one) and 'other' (a different one), across all grammatical inflections, prepositional prefixes, and article combinations.
The one coming after in temporal or sequential order; used to indicate the subsequent item in a series, translated as 'next' or 'following' rather than simply 'another.'
